<module id="freq_div">
    <description>Frequency divider for generating 50MHz, 10MHz, and 1MHz clocks from a 100MHz input clock.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="CLK_50">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</output>
        <output id="CLK_10">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</output>
        <output id="CLK_1">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="COUNTER_50">50</parameter>
        <parameter id="COUNTER_10">10</parameter>
        <parameter id="COUNTER_1">100</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt_50" width="6">Counter for 50MHz division.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt_10" width="4">Counter for 10MHz division.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt_100" width="7">Counter for 1MHz division.</reg>
        <wire id="CLK_50_reg">Register for CLK_50 output.</wire>
        <wire id="CLK_10_reg">Register for CLK_10 output.</wire>
        <wire id="CLK_1_reg">Register for CLK_1 output.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge CLK_in or negedge RST) begin
            if (!RST) begin
                cnt_50 <= 6'd0;
                cnt_10 <= 4'd0;
                cnt_100 <= 7'd0;
                CLK_50_reg <= 1'b0;
                CLK_10_reg <= 1'b0;
                CLK_1_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                cnt_50 <= cnt_50 + 1;
                if (cnt_50 == COUNTER_50) begin
                    CLK_50_reg <= ~CLK_50_reg;
                    cnt_50 <= 6'd0;
                end

                cnt_10 <= cnt_10 + 1;
                if (cnt_10 == COUNTER_10) begin
                    CLK_10_reg <= ~CLK_10_reg;
                    cnt_10 <= 4'd0;
                end

                cnt_100 <= cnt_100 + 1;
                if (cnt_100 == COUNTER_1) begin
                    CLK_1_reg <= ~CLK_1_reg;
                    cnt_100 <= 7'd0;
                end
            end
        end
        CLK_50 <= CLK_50_reg;
        CLK_10 <= CLK_10_reg;
        CLK_1 <= CLK_1_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
